why: The statement asks 28 sub-questions over fourteen numbers, so proving Catalan's constant irrational settles one restriction (rules out 'rational' for G) and is a case, not whole. All pi-measure events concern pi, which is not listed, so they are variants. Disjunctive and set-level results (Shidlovskii, Rivoal, Lima, Zudilin, Lai-Zhou) settle no individual number and score none, as do criteria, conditional routes and Wachs's critique. Sun's proof is knocked down: Wachs exhibits the exact failure the JUDGE text names (a quantity required negative computed positive), the author conceded errors, and no fix exists. OpenAI's family-005 manuscript is an independent case claim, unreviewed (Lean alone is not digestion, sorry status unknown), kept as doubtful because of its razor-thin margin; it is AI-generated per the README. Old unaccepted claims (Shi, Foukzon, Sopin) are not_credible on long silence plus later literature calling the questions open.
doubts: Sun's AI role: the recorded basis_quote is verification only (none), but the acknowledgements also say the numerical data in the proof were produced by AI and the 'novel idea' attribution is ambiguous; I chose assisted on the data claim. It does not affect counting since the event is knocked down. OpenAI-005's attribution is release-level ('vast majority'), not family-specific. Lean status for 005 is unestablished.
